summary: Google DeepMind published a Nature paper on its WeatherNext AI models achieving state-of-the-art cyclone track, intensity and wind-structure forecasts, and announced it is open sourcing the WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones model weights and code.

practices.reason: The document describes a domain-specific benchmarking methodology (comparing deterministic and probabilistic cyclone forecasts against other weather models) that is not transferable to general AI engineering evaluation practice.
practices.quote: We evaluated WeatherNext Cyclones on historical cyclones from 2023 to 2024, benchmarking its deterministic and probabilistic performance against other top weather models.
